verdict.rationale: n8n's GitHub materials say users can combine visual building with JavaScript, Python, and npm packages. A hands-on community user independently confirms that custom code blocks in JS and Python exist inside workflows, though with limited ability to import libraries. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the Code node itself (runtime, sandboxing, data access), and clarity on library and package import support given the community-reported limits.
